process_cpu.percent_semantics: 100% is one logical CPU fully busy; process threads can exceed 100%.

entire_sampled_lifetime.phase_boundary_measurement: Tick counters linearly interpolated between 0.5-second samples; excludes any unsampled leading/trailing interval.

replay_phase.phase_boundary_measurement: Tick counters linearly interpolated between 0.5-second samples; excludes any unsampled leading/trailing interval.

backlog_audit.endpoint: Actual audit subscriber monotonic receipt time, including synchronization and transport. Positive trend alone does not prove persistent callback accumulation.

additional_box_diagnostics.duration_semantics: Consecutive extra observations of the same detector track ID; frame absence breaks a run. Span is last-minus-first time; sampled duration is observations times median output interval, not physical occupancy duration.

summary.scope: Candidate diagnosis only; no algorithm or GT changes. Full-source publication history not recovered, never infer its recall from geometry.

actual_v2.saved_mask_recovery: Original complete1506 deterministic pass matched all logged decisions, then JSON serialization of numpy.bool_ failed. JSON recovered from 110 saved actual point/static/event/core/group masks, replay logs, and actual HF header matches. No EventDetector.step rerun during recovery; candidate bbox, membership and event fraction independently verified.
actual_v2.semantics: Annotations are evaluator-only voxel spatial reference support, not point-level physical ball labels. Counts use original frozen 5cm spatial rule and check reconstructed frozen voxel count/center. Primary precedence and overlapping categories both provided. Component min/max/high filters do not modify or rerun algorithm.

full_source.saved_mask_recovery: Original full1727 EventDetector.step and per-component membership verification completed and saved121 NPZ, then extra empty-window NaN failed JSON serialization. Recovery reruns current candidates only from saved true point/static/event masks and two actual prior source clouds nearest-HF ROI trees. Track history and publication decisions were not recovered, published metrics explicitly null. No full EventDetector.step rerun during recovery.
full_source.semantics: Labels used only for frozen geometry and voxel-spatial-support diagnostics, not algorithm decisions. Entire actual source processed; nearest real HF poses differ from actual_v2 synchronization. Additional neighboring input windows are diagnostics, not new GT. Reference support may contain wall/rope. Primary categories are precedence with overlapping evidence retained.

manifest.input: complete finite current registered XYZ within real-body world XY radius5m; no static or point-event deletion
manifest.pose: nearest real high-frequency pose by header timestamp

differences.raw: parents may exceed800 internally; ordinary/split returned raw regions cap800 true returns
differences.voxel: 5cm world grid mean representatives; core and minimum use raw support weights to preserve6 sparse returns; max800 applies to voxel count; bbox uses mapped real points; differs from production min/core voxel counts
differences.density_partition: Python borrowing existing density_partition.h, not PCL floating-point equivalence; all returned bodies become geometry candidates rather than selecting one confirmed body
differences.peaks: disjoint .08m local density-ascent basins; smallest input-index tie; raw parent fallback if no basin has6 real observations

independent_geometry.acceptance_scope: geometry-only candidate upper bound, fixed original strict center<.25m and maxside<.65m at113 stamps; not detection success, false-positive rate or full callback cost

manifest.candidate: all real raw ROI parents, .08m local density-ascent disjoint regions, raw6 fallback, no static/event deletion
manifest.novelty: unchanged two historical ROI KD nearest distances>.06m, min two fractions
manifest.association: unchanged .82m gate, consecutive priority, one-to-one, actual observations, ordinary3
manifest.events: unchanged core event labels, static points receive zero motion bits but remain candidates and event-fraction denominator
cautions: different body basins on the same object may make duplicate tracks
wall basins and near-target wall patches can compete with object trajectories
timing is concurrent offline screen, not full ROS callback or realtime backlog proof

independent_point_peaks.scope: offline actual-current published state geometry, same strict frozen predicate; no ROS four-topic consistency or realtime source coverage checked; old142/static/noball gates not evaluated

known_regression_failure.error: Existing measured body was lost at step 1 in original asymmetric body fixture
known_regression_failure.later_fixture: Equal-density physical 20 cm sphere bodies pass basic separation; does not establish all asymmetric body splits preserve parent.

performance_scope: Concurrent screening. Not solo performance qualification. CPU and RSS measured mapping_node only; prototype step timing is not ROS whole callback.
